name: Amphisbaena
otherStatistics: Perception +2. Blindsight 10 ft. Passive Perception 12. No languages.
appearance: An olive-brown snake with a head at each end of a single undulating body.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Tales from the Yawning Portal, first printing, April 2017, The Hidden Shrine of Tamoachan, area 39, Chamber of the Second Sun, printed p. 84, p. 85. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/tftyp It adapts Giant Constrictor Snake in Monster Manual (2014), printed p. 324. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16878-giant-constrictor-snake
sections.Actions:
Two melee attacks. On each of its turns the amphisbaena can make two melee attacks, with at most one Constrict.

Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and grapples the target (escape DC 16). The creature is restrained while the grapple lasts and the snake cannot constrict another target until the grapple ends.
sections.Encounter notes: The snake hides in rubble in the Chamber of the Second Sun. If it dies, four baboons enter from the hole above.

name: Elder Giant Lizard
otherStatistics: AC includes natural armor. Stealth +5. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 10. No languages.
appearance: A heavy-bodied lizard with olive scales, a broad head, four clawed feet, and a thick tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Tales from the Yawning Portal, first printing, April 2017, Against the Giants, area 21, Lizards’ Lair, printed p. 176, p. 177. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/tftyp It adapts Giant Crocodile in Monster Manual (2014), printed p. 324. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16880-giant-crocodile
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The lizard can hold its breath for 30 minutes.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tail attack.

Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage and grapples the target (escape DC 16). The target remains restrained and the lizard cannot bite a different target until that grapple ends.

Tail. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target the lizard is not grappling. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 16 Strength save or fall prone.
sections.Encounter notes: The mated pair raises four young in this cavern. The adults hunt in caverns below the lair and feed on fungi when they cannot find larger prey.

name: Giant Crayfish
otherStatistics: AC includes natural armor. Stealth +3. Blindsight 30 ft. Passive Perception 9. No languages in the Appendix B stat block.
appearance: An oversized crayfish with two broad pincers, a mottled ochre shell, sweeping antennae, and a fan-shaped tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Tales from the Yawning Portal, first printing, April 2017, Appendix B, Creatures, printed p. 235, p. 236. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/tftyp
sections.Traits: Amphibious. The crayfish can breathe air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.

Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) bludgeoning damage and grapples the target (escape DC 12). The crayfish has two claws and can grapple one target with each.
sections.Encounter notes: The guard in area 3 of the Hidden Shrine of Tamoachan speaks Olman. Six giant crayfish occupy an aquarium tier in White Plume Mountain.

name: Giant Lightning Eel
otherStatistics: Lightning damage resistance. Blindsight 60 ft. Passive Perception 11. No languages.
appearance: A long, dark-backed eel with a broad head, pale underside, and faint blue sparks.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Tales from the Yawning Portal, first printing, April 2017, Appendix B, Creatures, printed p. 236, p. 237. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/tftyp
sections.Traits: Water Breathing. The eel breathes only underwater.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.

Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) lightning damage.

Lightning Jolt (Recharge 5–6). Outside water, the eel touches one creature within 5 ft. In a body of water, it affects every creature within 15 ft. Each affected creature makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 13 (3d8) lightning damage and, if it takes any of that damage, is stunned until the end of the eel’s next turn. On a success, it takes half the damage and is not stunned.
sections.Encounter notes: Chae is the pet of the nereid Dasa Zotz in the Hidden Shrine of Tamoachan. When she calls for it, the eel strikes from near the surface of her pool.

name: Giant Subterranean Lizard
otherStatistics: AC includes natural armor. Stealth +3. Passive Perception 10. No languages or special senses.
appearance: A pale pink-white lizard with splayed toes and a long tapering tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Tales from the Yawning Portal, first printing, April 2017, Appendix B, Creatures, printed p. 236, p. 237. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/tftyp
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tail attack. The lizard can replace either one with Swallow.

Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage and grapples the target (escape DC 15). The target remains restrained and the lizard cannot bite a different target until that grapple ends.

Tail. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target the lizard is not grappling. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 15 Strength save or fall prone.

Swallow. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature the lizard is grappling. On a hit the target takes 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage, is swallowed, and is released from the grapple. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects outside the lizard, and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each lizard turn. The lizard can hold one swallowed target at a time. If the lizard dies, the swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can spend 10 ft. of movement to leave the corpse, exiting prone.
sections.Encounter notes: In the Forge of Fury the troglodytes chain a white-scaled specimen near a stream. It lashes with its tail before trying to seize and swallow prey.
